Author a guided tour#

Turn a scene link into a presentation: numbered hotspots a buyer can tap for a card, a guided tour that flies them from room to room with your narration, the sun where you want it, and a floor plan they can tap to walk anywhere. Everything is authored inside the viewer, on the real scene, and saved as an experience the share link plays.

You need: a Studio account (sign in at /studio) and a scene you own (upload it signed in, or Claim it). Authoring works on streamed scenes (ingest/<id>.vpk).

Open the Author bar#

From Studio, open the scene card's Experiences panel and press **New experience** — or add &author=1 to any link of a scene you own:

Code
https://HOST/?vpk=ingest/<id>.vpk&author=1

The Author bar appears on the right (bottom sheet on a phone). If you are not signed in, the status line says so; sign in at /studio and reload.

Drop hotspots#

  1. Walk or orbit to where the thing is.
  2. Press Drop hotspot, then click the surface you want the pin on — the kitchen island, the window, the wardrobe. The click lands the pin; the view you were looking from becomes the hotspot's jump view (what Go there and the tour use).
  3. Fill the card: a Title, Text (plain text; **bold**, *italic* and [links](https://…) work), an optional image URL from this origin (a published poster works) and an optional link.
  4. ↑ / ↓ reorder — the numbers on the pins follow. Set view re-captures the jump view from the current camera; Go jumps there.

Record the tour#

For each hotspot, stand where the camera should rest and press **Record step. The step keeps that camera pose; set its dwell** (seconds at rest), write the narration the visitor reads while the camera rests, and optionally attach an audio clip (mp3, m4a, ogg, wav or webm, up to 2 MB — it uploads when you save). The tour plays the steps in hotspot order, flying between them at a walking pace, and leaves the visitor standing at the last step. Preview tour plays it now.

Keep the sun#

Open Sun on the toolbar: move Azimuth, Elevation and Intensity, or enter a **date, time, latitude, longitude and UTC offset and press Place sun** — the sun lands where it would really be (set North if the plan is rotated; the default puts north at −Z). The link's ?sun= updates as you drag, so a bare link can carry a sun too. Leave "Save the current sun" ticked and the experience keeps it.

On lightmap-baked scenes the bake keeps its own light: only live-lit surfaces and the shadows they receive move.

Save and share#

  • Save publishes the experience (its own link shows under the buttons: /?experience=/v1/experience/<id>). Save again after edits — the same link updates in place.
  • Set as link default makes the scene's plain share link (/?vpk=ingest/<id>.vpk, the one on the Studio card and in embeds) play this experience. Studio's Experiences panel lists every experience of the scene, opens, edits, and switches or clears the default.

What visitors get#

Numbered pins over the scene; tap one for the card and Go there. Play tour on the toolbar runs the guided tour with your narration (text and audio). Plan orbits the home from above with the floor plan open — tap a room to walk there. Dollhouse frames the whole building; press it again to return. On phones the same controls are on the toolbar.

In an embed, viewer.playTour() starts the tour and hotspot, hotspots, tour-step and tour events report what happened; hotspots: false keeps the layer off (embed SDK).

Limits (honest)#

  • Pins are projected without depth: a pin behind a wall still shows (it fades with distance).
  • The plan teleports to the staged floor height — one storey per plan.
  • Audio autoplay follows the browser: if a clip does not start by itself, the player under the narration has a play button.
  • Bake-dominant scenes are not detected automatically; the Sun panel's note applies.
